name: EUPATORIUM PURPUREUM
key_symptoms: Left-sided headache with vertigo. Pain from left shoulder to occiput. Sick headache beginning in morning, worse afternoon and evening, worse in cold air.
Weight and heaviness in loins and back.
guiding_symptoms: Left-sided headache with vertigo. Pain from left shoulder to occiput. Sick headache beginning in morning, worse afternoon and evening, worse in cold air.
Weight and heaviness in loins and back.
head_symptoms: Left-sided headache with vertigo. Pain from left shoulder to occiput. Sick headache beginning in morning, worse afternoon and evening, worse in cold air.
urinary_symptoms: Deep, dull pain in kidneys. Burning in bladder and urethra on urinating. Insufficient flow; milky. Strangury. Hćmaturia. Constant desire; bladder feels dull. Dysuria. Vesical irritability in women. Diabetes insipidus.
musculoskeletal_symptoms: Weight and heaviness in loins and back.
fever_symptoms: No thirst during chill, but much frontal ache. Chill commences in back. Violent shaking, with comparatively little coldness. Bone-pains.

source.title: EUPATORIUM PURPUREUM - HOMOEOPATHIC MATERIA MEDICA - By William BOERICKE
